# Joel Martinez — push to main

> AI go-to-market for CEOs outside the SaaS bubble. I find who is worth a conversation, build the systems that keep finding them, and write about what is actually working when you sell something harder than software. Seattle.

## How I help CEOs

1. **Who is worth a conversation** — scored universes from real situations (funding, hiring, compliance, displacement), not persona workshops.
2. **A motion that reaches them** — phone, email, LinkedIn wired to that signal.
3. **Rails that run without me** — pipelines, CRM sync, reply routing, governance so the next closer inherits a system.

Ten years carrying a bag. AI-native enough to build what most operators wait on engineering for. Mineral rights, healthcare, hardware, M&A — where SaaS playbooks do not travel.

## Selected proof

- [Email From Zero](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/email-from-zero.md): Net-new cold-email for a phone-only mineral-rights company
- [Clinical Signal Platform](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/clinical-signal-platform.md): Healthcare data platform + federal exclusion screening
- [Scalphunter](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/scalphunter.md): M&A-arbitrage propensity universe — 1,336 companies
- [Merlin](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/merlin.md): Funding-round signal engine on Cloudflare
- [SEC Form D Pipeline](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/sec-form-d-pipeline.md): 14,749 newly-funded companies from ~99K filings
- [Punch GTM](https://pushtomain.xyz/work/punch-gtm.md): AI-powered outbound agency
